Subject: Follow-up: pre-workshop mapping and proposed tie-breaker rules

Quick follow-up from my side with a couple of practical items for the workshop so we can leave with an actionable map: 

1) Tie-breaker rule proposal (if PC Owner != Field Seller):
   - If consent timestamp within last 12 months -> PC Owner gets priority for claims
   - If consent older or missing -> Field Seller can claim if they have an active opportunity > $50k ARR
   - If both have active opportunities -> escalate to regional lead (Laura/Miguel) for final decision

2) Request for Alex (Fabrikam) — can you add a single column with current opportunity id and estimated ARR so we can apply the rule quickly?

3) I've populated the spreadsheet with our reconciled rows for the top 50 accounts and flagged 12 contested ones. See attached "fabrikam-account-map.xlsx" (tab: contested) and the short decision rubric I added in the first sheet.

If everyone is ok with this tie-breaker approach I'll add it to the handoff playbook and we can ratify during the call.

Ben Carter
